headline: US forces reimpose naval blockade on Iran, 9 ships diverted
summary: The US Central Command reports that nine commercial vessels have changed course following the new restrictions aimed at forcing Iran back to the negotiating table.
details: The US Central Command has announced that nine commercial ships have been forced to change their routes and one vessel has been rendered ineffective following the reimposition of a naval blockade against Iran.
The blockade was ordered by US President Donald Trump last week after a bilateral memorandum of understanding, brokered by the US, failed to be implemented.
Washington is using this economic and military pressure to push Iran back into negotiations based on its own terms.
This is not the first time such measures have been taken; a previous blockade from mid-April to mid-June had deprived Iran of billions of dollars in oil revenue.
Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf admitted in late June that during the previous blockade, Iran was unable to export a single barrel of crude oil abroad.
According to US Central Command, the first phase of the blockade resulted in the diverted routes of over 140 commercial ships and the complete neutralization of at least nine vessels.

headline_marked: Sweets distributed in Satkhira after [[Jamaat expels MP Gazi Nazrul Islam]]
headline: Sweets distributed in Satkhira after Jamaat expels MP Gazi Nazrul Islam
summary: The party took action following the spread of a 'private moment' video on social media, sparking celebrations among local residents.
details: Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami has expelled Member of Parliament Gazi Nazrul Islam from the party over allegations of 'moral degradation'.
The decision was made during an emergency meeting of the party's central executive council on Wednesday afternoon.
The expulsion follows the viral spread of a video on social media depicting the MP's 'private moments'.
Following the news, local residents in Shyamnagar, Satkhira, distributed sweets at the Shyamnagar crossroads and Banshipur intersection to celebrate the move.
Local BNP activist Moniruzzaman Sohag stated that people are happy with the expulsion of the MP whose morality was questioned.
Former Shyamnagar Upazila BNP convener Solaiman Kabir thanked Jamaat-e-Islami but called for the MP's seat to be cancelled and for legal action to be taken.
Satkhira District Jamaat General Secretary Azizur Rahman welcomed the central decision, stating that the party is based on moral ideals and the move was necessary to restore the party's image.
caption:
Sweets distributed in Satkhira as Jamaat-e-Islami expels MP Gazi Nazrul Islam over 'moral degradation'.

Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami has expelled Member of Parliament Gazi Nazrul Islam from the party over allegations of 'moral degradation'.

The decision was made during an emergency meeting of the party's central executive council on Wednesday afternoon.

The expulsion follows the viral spread of a video on social media depicting the MP's 'private moments'.

Following the news, local residents in Shyamnagar, Satkhira, distributed sweets at the Shyamnagar crossroads and Banshipur intersection to celebrate the move.

Local BNP activist Moniruzzaman Sohag stated that people are happy with the expulsion of the MP whose morality was questioned.

Former Shyamnagar Upazila BNP convener Solaiman Kabir thanked Jamaat-e-Islami but called for the MP's seat to be cancelled and for legal action to be taken.

Satkhira District Jamaat General Secretary Azizur Rahman welcomed the central decision, stating that the party is based on moral ideals and the move was necessary to restore the party's image.
